constraints: This policy consumes only compact scorer-entry candidates with positive reads.
Raw reads, RPM, and ranks remain attached to individual seq_id tests and are never summed across tests.
DNA/RNA concordance and repeated tests from one specimen form one reproducibility axis, not independent clinical confirmations.
Candidate forwarding is separated from the final Picked decision.
A top-three single-test signal or a reproducible top-ten signal is forwarded for clinical deterministic scoring even in a low-specificity family.
Phenotype evidence is not used by this shadow scorer until patient/event links are verified.
Context-prone and low-specificity families cannot become analytical-only Picked candidates.
No patient is forced to have a Picked candidate.
The policy is answer blind; benchmark answers are used only by a separate evaluator.
